name: Trigonometric ratios and special angles
subject: Maths
example_problem: Without a calculator, evaluate sin 60 x cos 30 - tan 45, and solve for x in a right-angled triangle where the hypotenuse is 13 and the side opposite x is 5.
prior_knowledge: Right-angled triangles and the theorem of Pythagoras

importance.summary: Gateway to Trigonometry - the biggest Paper 2 section: 40/100 in the Gr 10 final, 50/150 in Gr 11 and 40/150 in Gr 12.

required_by.topic: Trigonometry (reduction formulae, trig equations & general solutions)

covered_by.subtopic: Define sin, cos and tan in right-angled triangles
